framework_rationale: The submission imports only tensorcircuit alongside standard general-purpose numerical/optimization libraries (jax, numpy, optax), with no other quantum frameworks imported or used. All core quantum operations—initial state preparation via tc.Circuit and Hadamard gates, open-boundary TFIM Hamiltonian construction via tc.templates.graphs.Line1D and tc.quantum.heisenberg_hamiltonian, non-unitary exponential filter gates via tc.Circuit.exp1 with tc.gates._x_matrix and tc.gates._zz_matrix, state extraction/normalization via c.state() and tc.backend.norm, and energy expectation via tc.templates.measurements.operator_expectation—are performed legitimately through TensorCircuit with its JAX backend.
cheating_rationale: No hardcoded answers, hidden oracle access, test/reward tampering, or evaluator exploits are present. The code consumes only the evaluator-provided config dictionary, runs full variational optimization from the specified uniform initialization, does not print progress, and returns clean NumPy arrays.
fidelity_rationale: The implementation faithfully matches every detail of the problem specification: it constructs the open-boundary 18-qubit TFIM Hamiltonian H = -sum Z_i Z_{i+1} - 1.10 sum X_i from config values, prepares |+>^18, applies 10 brickwork cooling layers (5 even/odd blocks with bonds (0,1),...,(16,17) on even layers and (1,2),...,(15,16) on odd layers) using shared trainable exp(a_l X_i) and exp(b_l Z_i Z_{i+1}) filters via tc.Circuit.exp1 with theta = 1j * strength, normalizes the full state after every layer while differentiating through the normalization via jax.value_and_grad, initializes all parameters to initial_filter_strength, runs exactly max_steps=600 Adam updates at learning_rate=0.02 without early stopping, records energy density <H>/n_qubits immediately before each update, and returns final_a and final_b with shape (5, 2) and energy_density_history of length 600. The observed initial energy density (-1.1719), unchanged a[0,0] = 0.01 (exact zero gradient on |+>^18), and convergence to -1.32678 (within 1.1e-4 of exact -1.32690) corroborate the sign conventions and physics.
implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation errors were found. Gate conventions, brickwork bond parity, per-layer state rescaling, Hamiltonian sign and boundary conditions, Adam update loop, pre-update loss logging, and output shapes/dtypes are all consistent and verified.
